component.name: Backdrop
component.script:
sub init() m.text = m.top.findNode("text") m.time = m.top.findNode("time") m.date = m.top.findNode("date") m.hello = m.top.findNode("hello") m.weather = m.top.findNode("weather") m.hello.text = m.top.greeting
m.clock = m.top.findNode("clock") m.clock.observeField("fire", "tick") m.clock.control = "start" m.ticks = 0 tick()
m.fetch = CreateObject("roSGNode", "WeatherTask") m.fetch.observeField("result", "onWeather") m.fetch.control = "RUN" end sub
sub onGreeting() m.hello.text = m.top.greeting end sub
sub tick() now = CreateObject("roDateTime") now.ToLocalTime() h = now.GetHours() mins = now.GetMinutes() h12 = h mod 12 if h12 = 0 then h12 = 12 ampm = "AM" if h >= 12 then ampm = "PM" mm = mins.ToStr() if mins < 10 then mm = "0" + mm m.time.text = h12.ToStr() + ":" + mm + " " + ampm m.date.text = now.GetWeekday() + ", " + monthName(now.GetMonth()) + " " + now.GetDayOfMonth().ToStr() ' As a screensaver, move the text a little each minute so nothing burns in. m.ticks = m.ticks + 1 if m.top.drift and m.ticks mod 6 = 0 then spots = [[110, 640], [150, 610], [110, 580], [190, 640], [150, 660]] p = spots[(m.ticks / 6) mod spots.Count()] m.text.translation = p end if end sub
function monthName(n as Integer) as String names = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"] return names[n - 1] end function
sub onWeather() w = m.fetch.result if w <> invalid and w.temp <> invalid then line = w.temp.ToStr() + Chr(176) + " " + w.text if w.place <> invalid and w.place <> "" then line = line + " · " + w.place m.weather.text = line end if end sub
